rigorous_certificate.scope: Stationary fixed-theta iid gradient driver, not an actual parameter-learning trajectory

monte_carlo.purpose: Supplementary Monte Carlo; exact rational certificate proves the sign
monte_carlo.rng: std::mt19937_64 with inverse CDF Binomial(16,0.1) failure count
monte_carlo.bias_correction: Omitted after burn-in; difference vanishes exponentially and is not used by the proof
monte_carlo.interval_status: Asymptotic batch-means diagnostics, not rigorous probability intervals
